name: Ghost Crew
description: A starship roster terminal has surfaced on the local lab network, where a crew transfer is overdue and the manifest is suspect. Recover the protected crew record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Find the Real Crew
tasks.description: A starship roster terminal has surfaced on the local lab network, where a crew transfer is overdue and the manifest is suspect. Recover the protected crew record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Compare the roster entries with the terminal's operational metadata; some records do not fit the live system.
Cross-reference each credential record's generation value with the generation reported by the identity store.
Use the credential from the sole record whose generation matches the live identity store to access the protected crew record.
